text:
maya: Heads-up — Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus have agreed to a joint marketplace listing for the new managed connector. Need to align on technical smoke tests, embargo window, and co-marketing assets. Can we run a quick sync on dependencies?

samir: I can own perf and KV/cache behavior tests. timeline?

maya: Targeting announcement week of May 12. Embargo lift = Tue 2025-05-13 00:00 PT. That gives us 6 business days for cert + docs.

alex: Packaging note — our connector manifest needs: market_name, supported_models, quant_profiles, runtime_footprint. I'll push a manifest template by EOD.

juno: Legal asked for sample data flows + residency doc. @sr_snowflake_partner can Snow provide a privacy blurb we can link from the listing?

sr_snowflake_partner: yes, we'll share a short residency & compliance blurb. Expect a PR to the shared drive tomorrow. Also will provide marketplace listing JSON schema.

maya: Great. For smoke tests, I sketched a minimal checklist. Pls review and add gaps:```
- deploy connector to staging cluster
- ingest 10 small docs -> generate embeddings (512 dim)
- run 100 similarity queries, measure p95 latency < 120ms
- verify metadata passthrough + user_id hashing
- check rollback path on failure (auto-fallback to hosted model)
```

samir: Add: KV-cache validation — warm cache then 1000 short requests to check token emission and backend error rates. I'll own scripts.

alex: Also include packaging smoke step: `docker build --target release && ./validate_manifest.sh connector.json` — we should fail fast on manifest mismatches.

juno: Ops checklist: make sure marketplace listing excludes PII examples. Legal will redact sample payloads.

maya: Can ops-bot schedule a deployment slot for connector staging? Need GPU node + milvus test instance.

ops-bot: Deploy slot requested: 2025-05-06 09:00 PT -> 2025-05-06 12:00 PT. Cluster: staging-gpu-2, Milvus: milvus-staging-7. Ticket #PARTN-3842 created. :ok_hand:

sr_snowflake_partner: For co-marketing, our PM suggests a joint blog + marketplace spotlight tile. We'll coordinate PR windows. Who can provide a short tech blurb (3–4 sentences) for the listing?

maya: I'll draft the tech blurb. Alex — can you provide the quick install steps snippet for the marketplace page? 2–3 lines.

alex: Yep. Will draft 2-line install + env var notes and push to the shared doc.

samir: Quick call recommended to align test criteria and perf targets. 30m tomorrow?

maya: 30m tomorrow works. Proposed agenda: manifest + smoke checklist sign-off, embargo & legal blockers, staging deploy confirmation, co-marketing deliverables.

juno: +1. I'll invite legal rep for 10 mins.

sr_snowflake_partner: I'll join with marketing PM.

maya: Awesome. Action items recap:
- samir: perf & KV-cache scripts (due 2025-05-05)
- alex: manifest template + install snippet (due EOD today)
- juno: legal redaction checklist & residency doc (PR by 2025-05-04)
- sr_snowflake_partner: marketplace JSON + compliance blurb (by 2025-05-02)
- ops-bot: staging slot created (#PARTN-3842)

maya: If anything urgent ping me in #release-war-room. Otherwise see you on the sync. :rocket:
